_doc: The dashboard's registry. Each entry becomes a card on the index and a route at /<id>. `scripts` is what a refresh runs, in order, from the repo root — omit it for a report that is written by hand or produced by something outside this repo, and it will be served without a refresh button rather than pretending it has one. `data` is the JSON whose collectedAt drives the age indicator; omit it and the report's own file mtime is used instead. Any reports/*.html not listed here still appears on the index as unregistered, so a new report is reachable the moment it exists — adding it here is what gives it a title, an order, and a refresh.
